walkthrough:
Substitute $y = mx + c$ into the curve equation $xy = 16$ to form a quadratic in $x$:
$$x(mx + c) = 16 \implies mx^2 + cx - 16 = 0$$

Set the discriminant $b^2 - 4ac = 0$ for tangency:
$$c^2 - 4(m)(-16) = 0 \implies c^2 + 64m = 0$$

Solve for $m$ in terms of $c$:
$$64m = -c^2 \implies m = -\frac{c^2}{64}$$

Substitute $m = -4$ into the intersection quadratic $mx^2 + cx - 16 = 0$:
$$-4x^2 + cx - 16 = 0 \implies 4x^2 - cx + 16 = 0$$

Set the discriminant strictly positive for two distinct points of intersection:
$$(-c)^2 - 4(4)(16) > 0 \implies c^2 - 256 > 0$$

Factorise and state the set of values of $c$:
$$(c - 16)(c + 16) > 0 \implies c < -16 \quad\text{or}\quad c > 16$$
